raw_segments.text: Queen Elizabeth, send to her by the man that slew her brothers a pair of bleeding hearts,
Therefore present to her, as sometimes Margaret did to thy father, steeped in Rutland's blood
a handkerchief, which, say to her, did drain the purple sap from her sweet brother's body,
and bid her wipe her weeping eyes withal.
If this inducement move her not to love, send her a letter of thy noble deeds.
Tell her thou madstee away her uncle Clarence, her uncle Rivers, I, and for her sake madstee
quick conveyance with her good aunt Anne.
